versions.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-csas-device-health-monitor.

- Provides read-only health and risk monitoring for endpoint devices in Alibaba Cloud SASE (CSAS).
- Diagnoses CPU/memory pressure, battery health, disk saturation, and endpoint online status.
- Supports device and fleet scans with session-based user agent tracing, ensuring observability.
- Requires Aliyun CLI, jq, and sets up CLI plugin dependencies locally as needed.
- All cloud API calls are fully tracked and do not modify devices or global configurations.
- Clear bilingual metric labels and thorough coverage of five health/data dimensions.
